summary: The reported canonical YAML option succeeds in the prepared source. Commit db272201 removed the deprecated --mamba-scheduler-strategy registration before this base, leaving only the canonical argparse _StoreAction for mamba_radix_cache_strategy, so DeprecatedAliasStoreAction cannot shadow that destination. No production code change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The real ServerArgs parser registered only _StoreAction ['--mamba-radix-cache-strategy']; merging a YAML file containing mamba-radix-cache-strategy: no_buffer and parsing it produced no_buffer. Raw output: reports/j-c1b2f85b523f/raw/repro-before.txt

The real YAML and canonical CLI paths accepted their values; the retired --mamba-scheduler-strategy spelling was unrecognized; and a destination represented only by DeprecatedAliasStoreAction remained rejected by ConfigArgumentMerger. Raw output: reports/j-c1b2f85b523f/raw/parser-boundaries.txt
All four existing config parsing and ServerArgs integration tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-c1b2f85b523f/raw/test-config-integration.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The failure occurs entirely while argparse actions and YAML are merged, before model loading or device initialization. Parser-level execution exercises the reported path; GPU execution would not strengthen this claim.
remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B weights and four-GPU NVIDIA environment were not available or needed; no full model-serving or multi-GPU reproduction was claimed.

The generic ConfigArgumentMerger implementation can still classify a synthetic shared destination as unsupported when a supported action and DeprecatedAliasStoreAction are manually co-registered, but the prepared ServerArgs parser has no DeprecatedAliasStoreAction registrations, so this is not an active reproduction of the source issue.
The deprecated --mamba-scheduler-strategy CLI spelling is intentionally retired in the prepared source; this report validates the canonical option requested by the issue.
